name: Kawanehon (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Kawanehon town emblem in green and blue: a green disc of stylised hills crossed by a blue river.
history: Municipal flag of Kawanehon, a town in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 9 November 2005.

features.role: Kawanehon town emblem — a green disc of stylised hills crossed by a blue river
